title: Baby Huey
extract: Baby Huey is a gigantic and naïve duckling cartoon character. He was created by Martin Taras for Paramount Pictures' Famous Studios, and became a Paramount cartoon star during the 1950s. Huey first appeared in Quack-a-Doodle-Doo, a Paramount Noveltoon theatrical short produced in 1949 and released in 1950.
